messages:
anya: Heads up — eval-runner is piling up 'waiting for shard' after the scheduler tweak earlier. ~1.2k pending across quant experiments. anyone seeing this? :eyes:
sam: Yep saw alerts. Queues are backed and retries are spiking, latency skyrocketed for the q4_0 experiments.
ci-bot: deploy finished: eval-scheduler v2027.03.14 (commit 8f3b2a) by @kevin
marta: grabbing logs now. quick grep shows repeated failures during shard spin-up:
```
2027-03-14T10:12:05Z shard-manager: request=shard-47 action=spinup status=error reason=lease-acquire-timeout
2027-03-14T10:12:05Z worker-provisioner: shard=shard-47 retries=0 err="no healthy nodes"
2027-03-14T10:12:06Z shard-manager: request=shard-47 action=retry backoff_ms=100
```

marta: also a lot of immediate retries (backoff 100ms) -> thundering retry pattern.
kevin: scheduler change reduced default spinup backoff to 100ms to make tests faster — oops. that explains retry storm + autoscaler thrash.
raj: adding that some q4_0 quant jobs are OOMing on worker init so they never become healthy; combined with aggressive retries autoscaler thinks nodes are underutilized and downsizes. seeing crashloops on nodepool-quant via: `kubectl get pods -l app=eval-worker -o wide | grep CrashLoopBackOff`
anya: ugh. so two problems: aggressive retry/backoff + flaky quant worker init. temporary mitigation ideas?
sam: propose revert the scheduler backoff change (restore 2s default) and set scheduler to quarantine failing shards after 3 attempts. also throttle max parallel spinups to 50.
kevin: rolling back now. ops-bot do you have the rollback playbook id?
ops-bot: rollback playbook invoked: eval-scheduler revert to v2027.03.13 (playbook run id rb-447). initiating 2min canary then full roll.
ci-bot: CI pipelines: triggering post-rollback smoke: `make smoke-tests` on eval-harness.
marta: quick bandaid to reduce noise: increased `eval/scheduler/max_retries` to 3 and `eval/scheduler/spinup_backoff_ms` to 2000 in runtime config. also muting the 'waiting for shard' pager for 10m.
raj: I'll dig into the q4_0 OOMs — hypothesis: quant lib alloc path changed memory footprint at init (log shows +200MB peak before crash). adding more guardrails in worker image to fail fast and report memory usage.
anya: nice. once rollback completes, let's monitor prefix-miss rate and queue-time histogram. if stable after 15m we can un-mute alerts. :thumbsup:
kevin: rollback completed on canary, rolling to prod. will follow up with postmortem notes.
ops-bot: rollout complete: eval-scheduler v2027.03.13 restored.
ci-bot: smoke-tests: 12/12 passed (short-run evals).
anya: thanks team. follow-up action items: raj investigate q4_0 init OOM (owner=raj), add exponential backoff on spinup (owner=kevin), add shard quarantine on repeated init failures (owner=marta). I'll start the postmortem doc.
sam: adding a metric request: expose spinup_retry_count and spinup_backoff_ms to the dashboard so we can alert before retries cross the thundering threshold.
anya: agreed. I'll add to the dashboard PR.
kevin: will also add a CI test that simulates slow worker init to prevent regressions.
anya: ok closing thread, will link the postmortem when ready.
